newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shiseido shares rise on buying led by foreigners.
newsitem.headline: Shiseido shares rise on buying led by foreigners.

text.p: Shares in Shiseido Co Ltd continued to gain ground on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Monday morning on buying led by foreign brokerages, dealers said.
As of 0103 GMT, the shares stood at 1,870 yen, up 30 yen from Friday's closing.
The shares has been rising for the last three trading days.

A dealer at a foreign brokerage said that domestic and overseas institutional investors often select Shiseido when they include cosmetic and other toiletry issues in their portfolio because of the company's business performance and liquidity of the shares.
